_doc: Source recordings of tut01 (read by index.tsx and scripts/tutorial_clips.py). Coordinates everywhere (bounds, blur, beats) are pixels of the RAW file (New.mp4 is 3840x2160). bounds = the page viewport: the browser tab strip + URL bar (y < 132) and the Windows taskbar (y >= 2088) are outside it and never drawn. Clips are cut as crops of bounds, scaled to clipWidth (3840 = full 4K resolution, so text stays sharp up to ~2x zoom on the 1080p output). blur = always-on privacy blur (account name + avatar, top-right; the nav bar is sticky so it never moves). The OBS window shows in the first 0.3 s and from 13:51 (831 s): never use those. The account blur is skipped while a panel is fullscreen (367.43-370.0, 374.47-379.567): the account isn't on screen then and the box would sit next to the exit icon.
